The ideal candidate will combine deep product expertise with strong consulting skills to establish implementation blueprints, accelerate client adoption, and drive successful business outcomes.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead end\-to\-end Radius implementations for enterprise clients.

* Assess client business requirements and translate them into scalable Radius solutions.
* Advise clients on process design, configuration, integration, and adoption strategies.
* Conduct discovery workshops and solution design sessions with business stakeholders.
* Identify implementation risks and develop mitigation strategies.
* Drive governance, deployment planning, testing, and go\-live activities.
* Provide guidance to delivery teams and ensure adherence to implementation standards.
* Develop implementation playbooks, documentation, and knowledge assets.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives based on lessons learned across client engagements.

* 8\+ years of enterprise application implementation experience.
* Extensive hands\-on experience implementing Radius across multiple client engagements.
* Strong understanding of client onboarding, requirements gathering, solution design, and deployment methodologies.
* Demonstrated ability to create implementation blueprints and reusable delivery frameworks.
* Experience managing stakeholder expectations and driving executive\-level discussions.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and consulting skills.
* Experience working with cross\-functional business and technical teams.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.



  




* **Preferred Qualifications**
* Radius product certifications or equivalent expertise.
* Experience leading large\-scale transformation or modernization initiatives.
* Knowledge of enterprise integrations, APIs, and data migration strategies.
* Experience in retail, supply chain, OMS, or related enterprise platforms.

title: Senior Consultant - Project Controls
description:
**Job Description**
 We are seeking a capable individual to support commercial, contract management, and cost management activities across UK\&I Transport \& Infrastructure projects.
   

  

 The role is focused on delivery and execution, enabling project teams in contract administration, change control, cost tracking, and commercial reporting while ensuring compliance with UK standards.
   

  

 The position works closely with PMO, Project Managers, and senior commercial leads, providing direct support to the Principal Consultant, ensuring high\-quality, timely, and data\-driven commercial delivery across projects
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Project Commercial Delivery
* Support the project management team in all aspects of contract administration.
* Assist in:
+ Change control (pricing, tracking, and forecasting)
+ Compensation events, variations, and claims support
+ Cost tracking, forecasting, and reporting

* Contribute to preparation of:
+ Cost estimates and budgets
+ CVRs, financial reports, and cashflow updates
+ Procurement documentation and tender support

* Contract Administration \& Controls
* Manage and maintain contractual registers:
+ Early Warning Notices (EWN)
+ General Communications (GC)
+ Compensation Events (CE)

* Track contractual timelines and highlight upcoming deadlines.
* Support drafting of contractual communications and notifications.
* Assist in ensuring compliance with contractual requirements, including mobilisation processes.
* Cost, Risk \& Commercial Support
* Support cost control and financial monitoring across project lifecycle.
* Assist in the maintenance of commercial risk registers.
* Support identification and tracking of risks, opportunities, and entitlements.
* Assist with claims, including inflation and commercial adjustments.
* Provide support in resolving client commercial issues such as withheld or disallowed costs.
* PMO Integration \& Coordination
* Work with PMO and Project Controls teams to align commercial data with programme and delivery.
* Ensure change impacts are reflected in schedules and cost forecasts.
* Support coordination of dashboards, trackers, and commercial reporting outputs.
* Governance \& Compliance
* Support adherence to defined commercial processes, templates, and standards.
* Ensure accuracy, consistency, and quality in commercial outputs.
* Participate in QA/QC reviews and ensure documentation completeness.
* Digital Tools \& Reporting
* Use tools such as:
+ Advanced Excel (Power Query, Pivot Tables)
+ Power BI (supporting dashboard reporting)

* Support maintenance of structured commercial trackers and registers.
* Contribute to data\-driven reporting and improved visibility.
* Exposure to CostX / 2D–5D measurement / BIM workflows is desirable and encouraged.
* Stakeholder Coordination
* Collaborate with Project Managers, PMO teams and Principal Consultants.
* Support communication between GCC and UK teams.
* Provide timely and accurate commercial inputs to support project delivery.


**Essential**
**QUALIFICATIONS**
* Bachelor’s degree in Quantity Surveying / Civil Engineering (Master’s preferred).
* 6 \- 10 years of QS / Cost Management / Commercial experience, including UK project exposure.
* Experience working in a professional services / infrastructure / engineering environment.
* Strong knowledge of:
+ NEC, JCT contracts
+ NRM, CESMM measurement standards
+ RIBA Stage 0–4 cost planning

* Experience in:
+ Change control and contract administration
+ Cost tracking, forecasting, and reporting
+ Maintaining contract registers and commercial documentation

* Exposure to working with international teams or projects.
* Proficiency in Excel and reporting tools.


**Tools \& Technology**
* CostX (advanced – 2D/3D/5D)
* Advanced MS Excel (Power Query, Pivot Tables)
* Power BI (dashboarding and reporting)
* Microsoft Office Suite (PowerPoint, Word)
* Exposure to BIM/5D workflows and digital cost management systems


**Desirable**
* Professional membership and Professional Qualification (e.g., RICS, APM)
* Experience in Rail, Roads, Civils, Water or Infrastructure projects
* Exposure to ERP systems and structured cost databases

title: Systems Integration Specialist-Citrix
description:
**Req ID:** 
 380520
   

  

 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
   

  

 We are currently seeking a Systems Integration Specialist\-Citrix to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN\-UP), India (IN).
   

  

 L2 JD
   

  

**Job Description**
 The VDI Systems Integration Advisor is a seasoned professional with a proven track record of relying on their innovation, creativity, technical prowess and leadership skills to deliver robust, efficient and stable solutions to their clients.
   

  

 The Advisor is a resource who has demonstrable experience supporting and managing large enterprise environments. Applicants should be highly motivated, technology driven, possess strong communications skills, can develop strong cross\-group collaboration and are willing to take on the challenge of dealing with ambiguity. Candidates should also have a broad understanding of both server and desktop / application virtualization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Support on all escalated incidents from lower levels of support.
* Tasks and alert management. Respond to critical monitoring alerts including server alerts and system outages.
* Assess and implement complex VDI / App Delivery Virtualization projects using various technologies.
* Support complex system configurations and standards for Citrix, VMware and MS Hyper\-V platforms.
* Support the team when technical issues arise within scope of expertise.
* Develop repeatable standards and implementation processes to ensure product uniformity and quality.
* Directly interact with clients, account managers, and peers in support of complex VDI / App Delivery environments.
* Apply best practices, strategies, methodologies, and approaches to large\-scale projects.
* Create and maintain support documentation, work instructions, and knowledge base articles.
* Drive high\-severity incidents within the scope of the role.
* Participate in 24/7 on\-call rotation.
* Adhere to Change Management and other ITIL processes.
* Accurately document support requests and troubleshooting steps.


**Required Skills**
* 5\+ years of IT infrastructure technical implementation experience required.
* 5\+ years of engineering and/or support experience related to x86 technical offerings such as VMware, Microsoft, and Citrix.
* Advanced and proven track record of engineering and supporting highly available Citrix environments involving Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops and/or Citrix DaaS. CCA highly preferred.
* 3\+ years of experience with Azure Virtual Desktop.
* Basic knowledge of storage subsystems.
* Server hardware fundamentals.
* Basic technical knowledge on on\-premise hypervisors including vSphere, XenServer, Microsoft Hyper\-V, and SQL. VCA VMware Certified Associate highly preferred.
* Extensive skills with Windows Networking, Active Directory, and profile management.
* Thorough understanding of enterprise datacenter technologies including Networking, Security, TCP/IP, SAN and NAS, and physical datacenter practices.
* Demonstrated ability to assess, implement, and troubleshoot IT Infrastructure systems and configurations using procedures, scripts, and templates.
* Demonstrated engineering expertise in gathering requirements, problem solving, and recommending solutions in mid\-sized customer environments.
* Demonstrated ability to achieve high Customer Satisfaction on engineering engagements.
* Respect deadlines and procedures agreed at team level or with the customer.
* Ability to listen, learn, and improve.
* Excellent English skills, both written and verbal.
* Nice to have: Windows 365, AWS WorkSpaces.

title: GeM & Tendering Expert
description:
We are looking for a detail\-oriented and process\-driven GeM \& Tender Executive to manage our organization's end\-to\-end presence and business on the Government e\-Marketplace (GeM) portal and other government tender platforms (CPPP, e\-Procurement portals, state portals, etc.). The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience across the complete GeM lifecycle — from vendor onboarding and assessment to bidding, reverse auction, forward auction, order fulfilment, and payment realization.
   




**Key Responsibilities** 

  





***GeM Portal Management***




 •     Manage day\-to\-day operations on the GeM portal including seller/vendor profile management, catalogue creation, and product/service listing.
 



 •     Ensure timely completion of vendor assessment processes, including document submission, compliance checks, and empanelment requirements.
 



 •     Monitor and maintain OEM/vendor authorization, brand approval, and product category approvals on GeM.
 



 •     Keep vendor assessment score, seller rating, and compliance metrics updated and healthy.
 



  





***Bidding \& Tendering***




 •     Search, shortlist, and evaluate relevant Bids/RFPs (Direct Purchase, L1 Bid, Custom Bid) and tenders on GeM and other e\-procurement platforms.
 



 •     Prepare and submit techno\-commercial bids, ensuring accuracy of pricing, technical specifications, and compliance with tender terms.
 



 •     Track bid submission deadlines, EMD (Earnest Money Deposit) payment, and document submission timelines.
 



 •     Coordinate with internal teams (finance, technical, logistics) for tender document preparation, pricing strategy, and eligibility criteria fulfilment.
 



  





***Reverse Auction (RA)***




 •     Participate actively in Reverse Auction (RA) events, monitoring live bidding and applying competitive pricing strategies within approved cost limits.
 



 •     Analyze competitor pricing patterns and market rates to strategize bid decrements.
 



 •     Ensure timely and accurate participation in RA to maximize win rate while maintaining profitability.
 



  





***Forward Auction***




 •     Manage and participate in Forward Auction processes on GeM, ensuring compliance with auction rules and timelines.
 



 •     Coordinate pricing approvals internally before auction participation.
 



 •     Track auction outcomes and maintain records for management review.
 



  





***Order \& Contract Management***




 •     Process Purchase Orders (PO)/Contracts received via GeM — verify terms, acknowledge orders, and coordinate execution timelines.
 



 •     Track order fulfilment status: dispatch, delivery, installation (if applicable), and consignee acceptance.
 



 •     Manage CRAC (Consignee Receipt\-cum\-Acceptance Certificate) generation and follow\-up.
 



 •     Handle order cancellations, replacements, and returns as per GeM guidelines.
 



  





***Payments \& Compliance***




 •     Track and follow up on payment realization through GeM's integrated payment system (PFMS/bill processing).
 



 •     Ensure GST invoicing, e\-way bills, and other statutory compliance for each transaction.
 



 •     Maintain documentation for performance bank guarantees (PBG), EMD refunds, and other financial instruments as required.
 



  





***Reporting \& Coordination***




 •     Maintain MIS/trackers for bids submitted, RA/FA participation, orders won, and payment status.
 



 •     Liaise with government buyers, procurement officers, and internal stakeholders to resolve queries or disputes.
 



 •     Stay updated on GeM policy changes, GFR (General Financial Rules), and CVC guidelines relevant to public procurement.
   




**Required Skills \& Competencies** 

 •     Strong working knowledge of the GeM portal — bidding, RA, FA, catalogue management, and vendor assessment modules.
 



 •     Familiarity with public procurement processes, GFR, and government tendering norms.
 



 •     Good understanding of pricing strategy and competitive bidding techniques.
 



 •     Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint for tracking and reporting.
 



 •     Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple deadlines simultaneously.
 



 •     Good communication and coordination skills for liaising with government departments and internal teams.
 



 •     Basic understanding of GST, e\-invoicing, and financial documentation related to tenders.
   




**Qualifications** 

 •     Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Engineering, or related field (MBA preferred but not mandatory).
 



 •     2–5 years of relevant experience in GeM operations, government tendering, or public sector sales.
 



 •     Prior experience working with GeM Sahayak/Seller Panel is a strong plus.
